messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Canary failure detected for deployment `inference-worker` in eu-west-1 cluster — 3/5 canary pods CrashLoopBackOff, HPA reacting with scale-ups and rapid evictions. Creating thread.

marta.r: taking it. paging @sam.sre and @jin.k — I'm oncall for infra this shift.

sam.sre: on it. adding severity P1 until we know customer impact. pinging @emily.cs for CS heads-up.

deploy-bot: New canary rollout started: inference-worker:v2.4 -> 3 replicas. Canary window 15m. (deploy id: d-2026-03-15-02)

jin.k: running `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-worker -o wide` — output snippet:
```
NAME                                    READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
inference-worker-canary-5f8d9c7d4-abc1   0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   3          6m
inference-worker-canary-5f8d9c7d4-def2   1/1     Running            0          5m
inference-worker-canary-5f8d9c7d4-ghi3   0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   4          4m
```

marta.r: logs from one crash:
```
POST /health 404 "GET /liveness" "probe failed"
preStop: sleep 45
error: logger: failed to init encoder: config parse error: unknown field 'encoder_flags'
panic: failed to start
```

sam.sre: whoa — malformed manifest field `encoder_flags` slipped into the canary. preStop sleep 45 is making term longer -> HPA terminating pods slowly -> node drain/eviction churn. That'll trigger HPA and cause thrash.

emily.cs: CS: seeing a handful of EU customers reporting 502s and increased latency for embeddings requests. Not widespread but a few paying customers are affected. tallying IDs.

marta.r: immediate mitigation options:
- flip feature flag (product) that enables new encoder: `FF_ENCODER_V2` -> false
- revert the deployment to previous working image with `kubectl rollout undo` OR `kubectl set image`
- temporarily pause/scale HPA to stable minReplicas=2

jin.k: trying flip of feature flag now — pinging product feature-flags service: `/flags/FF_ENCODER_V2?env=prod` -> current `true`. sending PATCH to set false.

product-bot: Feature flag update queued: FF_ENCODER_V2 -> false (initiated by jin.k). Waiting for confirmation to publish.

marta.r: do the publish. we need to stop new pods loading broken config.

jin.k: published. feature-flags: FF_ENCODER_V2=false :white_check_mark:

sam.sre: good. but existing canary pods will still crash on start. recommend rollback image to v2.3 as a fast safety net. I'll run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-worker -n prod --to-revision=12` unless objections.

marta.r: go ahead

jin.k: running rollback...
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-worker --to-revision=12
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference-worker --watch
```

deploy-bot: Rollback started for inference-worker -> rolling update to image inference-worker:v2.3

jin.k: rollback progressing. new pods coming up. monitoring logs.

marta.r: while that finishes, patch HPA to avoid thrash. applying `kubectl patch hpa inference-worker -n prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'` and set targetCPU to 60 -> 65.

sam.sre: patch applied. HPA now minReplicas=2 targetCPU=65

jin.k: rollout complete: all replicas Running. verifying health endpoints. `curl -v http://inference-worker.prod.svc/health` -> 200 OK on canaries.

emily.cs: CS update: we pushed a notification to impacted customers, asking them to retry. a couple reported immediate recovery. continuing to monitor.

marta.r: good. postmortem checklist:
- keep this thread until postmortem written
- capture manifests diff that introduced `encoder_flags` and `preStop` change
- check why linter didn't catch unknown field
- ensure feature flag gating is in rollout checklist

sam.sre: adding action: add a validation schema check in CI for deployment manifests to fail on unknown fields. will file ticket: INFRA-3421

jin.k: also recommend reducing default preStop to 5s and adding graceful shutdown readiness probe. I'll open a PR to revert the preStop change and add tests.

marta.r: severity -> P2 now. removing active page but keeping pager duty on-call in loop for 1h.

oncall-bot: Incident thread created: incident/2026-03-15-inference-canary-manifest. Severity P2. Assigned owners: marta.r, jin.k, sam.sre.

emily.cs: Customers updated, support cases created: CS-1289, CS-1290. keep me posted if we should offer credits.

sam.sre: quick follow-up: found the manifest PR that caused this — it included a local test-only field `encoder_flags` that slipped through because the deployment linter config didn't enforce schema for kustomize overlays. adding that to TODO list.

marta.r: thanks everyone. final checklist: postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow, include timeline, customer impact, and remediation tasks. closing thread when postmortem published. :thumbsup:

jin.k: ack. will paste kube diffs and pod logs into the postmortem doc.

marta.r: closing the active mitigation. keeping this thread as record. :white_check_mark:
